name: Framework help (drafts)
description: Help mode entries for framework. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Session
entries.text: Opens Session.

entries.title: Brief ( characters)
entries.text: Shows “Brief ( characters)”.

entries.title: UI Review
entries.text: Shows “UI Review”.

entries.title: The build
entries.text: Shows “The build”.

entries.title: Console
entries.text: Shows “Console”.

entries.title: axHub
entries.text: Shows “axHub”.

entries.title: Replay the animation
entries.text: Replays the animation.

entries.title: Preset
entries.text: Where you set “Preset”. Change it and the app uses the new value.

entries.title: Reset open menus and width
entries.text: Resets open menus and width. Your own changes go.

entries.title: Pinned
entries.text: Turns “Pinned” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered.

entries.title: Shown
entries.text: Turns “Shown” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered.

entries.title: Accent
entries.text: Where you set “Accent”. Change it and the app uses the new value.

entries.title: Reset custom to default
entries.text: Throws away this app's own copy of the settings interface and goes back to the shared default one.

entries.title: Tabs on top
entries.text: Lays the settings interface out with its tabs in a row along the top.

entries.title: Tabs at the side
entries.text: Lays the settings interface out with its tabs in a column down the side.

entries.title: List
entries.text: Shows every setting in one long list, no tabs.

entries.title: Full
entries.text: The settings interface's header shows in full: title, description and actions.

entries.title: Compact
entries.text: The settings interface's header shrinks to one short line.

entries.title: None
entries.text: The settings interface shows no header at all.

entries.title: Search field
entries.text: Adds a search box at the top of this settings interface.

entries.title: Descriptions
entries.text: Shows the one-line description under each setting.

entries.title: Hidden ids (comma-separated: a tab, group or field key)
entries.text: Ids to leave out of this settings interface, separated by commas: a tab, a group or one setting's key.

entries.title: Banner settings (look, behaviour, Apply to all)
entries.text: Opens the Banners settings: this banner's look and behaviour, and Apply to all.

entries.title: Find a setting
entries.text: Type part of a setting's name to jump straight to it.

entries.title: Pop out to window
entries.text: Moves this dialog into a floating window you can move, resize and dock.

entries.title: More
entries.text: The tabs that don't fit in the row: pick one from this list.

entries.title: New tab
entries.text: Opens something new as a tab in this pane. Pick an app, a page, or another copy of this tab.

entries.title: Undo
entries.text: Puts back what the last drop did: a tab it opened closes again, a tab it moved goes back.
